item.description: I enjoy investigating microbial communities and how they impact the global climate cycle. In my free time, I like to go white water rafting and running with my dog, Naomi. I am still very early in my academic career, so I am always trying to learn as much as possible!

I am interested in studying how carbon moves through microbial communities and the mechanisms by which it does so. I look into metabolomic data to trace the movement of isotopically-labeled carbon and nitrogen over time. I am also interested by how enzymes and their activity varies in sediments and how this effects the communities using those enzymes.
